svg.title: Security toolkit
svg.desc: Recon & OSINT: Nmap,Shodan,theHarvester,Maltego,Tor,Amass,Recon-ng,SpiderFoot,Sherlock; Web security: Burp Suite,OWASP ZAP,Nikto,sqlmap,Gobuster,ffuf,WPScan,Nuclei,dirsearch; Offensive security: Metasploit,Hashcat,Hydra,John the Ripper,Aircrack-ng,Impacket,NetExec,Responder,BloodHound,Mimikatz,Evil-WinRM; Defensive analysis: Wireshark,Snort,VirusTotal,Splunk,YARA,YARA-X,tcpdump,Zeek,Suricata,Sysmon,Velociraptor,Volatility,ELK and Elastic,Sigma; Reverse engineering: Ghidra,IDA,radare2,Cutter,x64dbg,GDB,Binary Ninja,dnSpy,Frida,objdump,PE-bear,Detect It Easy,HxD,WinDbg,Procmon
svg.text: A working reference across the security spectrum. Green marks the tools I use most.
